Name: Krobus Patio and Sewer
Author: tikamin557
Description:
The path from the sewers is blocked if you do not live with Krobus.

If you use a custom farm map where the location of the spouse patio is different from the vanilla location, when you warp from the sewer to the farm, it will warp to a strange location.
In that case, the warp coordinates can be changed in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig [/url]settings.
Installation of "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url]" is also strongly recommended for obtaining coordinates.

[color=#ffff00][size=5]Other compatible mods.[/size][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5751]A Cleaner Sewer[/url]
